recorded_by: operator directive of 2026-08-29, executed in session

ordering_discipline.rule: object first, prove the object, only then the estimand
ordering_discipline.why_it_cannot_be_inverted: Study 5 has never held a PHENOMENON-level positive control, only an instrument-level one (P-0's CUE at the embedding output, 0.9862). Without an object whose intermediate is known to be computed, an estimand can only ever be checked against synthetic cases; with one, choosing an estimand becomes model selection WITH ground truth, which is legitimate
ordering_discipline.what_is_registered_in_this_file: the object, its validity proofs, the floors, and both conclusion wordings
ordering_discipline.what_is_NOT_registered_in_this_file: the estimand, which remains HELD and is settled only after the object is proven

1_the_object.task: NAME -> letter -> digit. The prompt registers names under letters and gives a letter-to-digit table; the question asks for the value registered to one name. The ANSWER is the digit; the INTERMEDIATE is the letter.

1_intermediate_known.how: the letter IS the build parameter

2_intermediate_never_the_emitted_token.how: intermediates are LETTERS and answers are DIGITS; the token-id sets are checked disjoint at build time over every single-token surface form either vocabulary can produce
2_intermediate_never_the_emitted_token.why_it_is_a_vocabulary_property_and_not_: so that no individual item can violate it

3_both_hops_real.how: the letter-to-digit table is randomised per pair, so the second hop cannot be known in advance; the first hop's input is removed by the ablation probe

4_model_accuracy.floor_provenance: the adjudicator suggested at least 0.80 and left the value to the executing party; 0.80 is adopted unchanged as a round number well above the 0.1111 chance rate, and is not fitted to anything
4_model_accuracy.measured_on: clean runs of the constructed items, top-1 continuation equals the built answer digit

5_enough_correct_both_units.floor_units: units correct on BOTH sides in the clean runs
5_enough_correct_both_units.floor_provenance: set by the executing party as the directive requires. 60 clusters gives a cluster bootstrap enough resampling units for a percentile interval to be meaningful, and it is well above P-0''s 30, which had been set for a frame with far fewer usable pairs. It is a round number chosen for being unremarkable

disclosure.what_was_known: that 160 pairs were built and that P-0 measured 32.61 percent accuracy on a DIFFERENT, borrowed item set

6_equal_token_length.how: the two members of a pair differ only in the queried name, and the pair is admitted only if the two names tokenise to the same length IN THE QUESTION LINE
6_equal_token_length.why_in_context: a name that is one token bare can be two tokens after a space; filtering on the bare form admits misaligned pairs

7_bridge_tokens_identical.how: everything after the queried name is fixed template text

2_the_anti_retrieval_proof.probe: the same prompt with the queried name's own registration line removed
2_the_anti_retrieval_proof.why_it_is_the_right_probe: it removes the FIRST hop's input while leaving the second hop's clue, the rules table, entirely intact. A model that could answer anyway would be retrieving rather than composing
2_the_anti_retrieval_proof.why_the_answer_is_not_recoverable: the letter-to-digit table is randomised per pair and the name-to-letter assignment appears nowhere else in the prompt
2_the_anti_retrieval_proof.registered_criterion: ablated accuracy must be at or below chance plus a tolerance
2_the_anti_retrieval_proof.tolerance_provenance: a round allowance for finite-sample fluctuation and for any residual surface bias in digit priors; not fitted
2_the_anti_retrieval_proof.must_also_hold: full accuracy minus ablated accuracy must exceed 0.50, so the drop is unambiguous rather than marginal
2_the_anti_retrieval_proof.if_it_fails: the object is not established; stop and report, and do not patch

3_conclusion_wordings_fixed_before_any_m.why_they_are_registered_now: so that whichever estimand is later settled on inherits wordings it could not have shaped

OBJECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED.recorded_as: P-0c determination: the constructed object is not established, and no patching was performed on it.
OBJECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED.verbatim: The constructed two-hop object failed one of its registered validity requirements: either the model does not answer it above the registered accuracy floor, or the ablation probe did not collapse to chance, which would mean the second hop can be answered without the first. In either case the object does not carry a known-computed intermediate, and patching it would produce numbers about an object that does not have the property the numbers would be interpreted as measuring. NOTHING IS CONCLUDED ABOUT REAL ITEMS, ABOUT THE J-LENS, OR ABOUT ANY MODEL. This is a failure to build an instrument, not a finding about anything.
OBJECT_NOT_ESTABLISHED.required_next_action: stop and report; do not weaken a requirement, do not adjust the object to pass, do not proceed to any estimand work

OBJECT_ESTABLISHED.recorded_as: P-0c determination: the constructed object is established as a known-positive selection set.
OBJECT_ESTABLISHED.verbatim: The model answers the constructed two-hop items above the registered accuracy floor, and removing the first hop's input collapses accuracy to chance. The intermediate is therefore known BY CONSTRUCTION and is required BY THE TASK, and the object may serve as the selection set on which candidate estimands are compared. THIS IS A PROPERTY OF A CONSTRUCTED OBJECT AND NOTHING ELSE. It is not a result about real items, it is not a phenomenon-level positive control for the multihop set, and it licenses no claim about J-space, the J-lens, the paper, or T. A constructed object is a selection set, and success on a selection set is not success on an application set.
OBJECT_ESTABLISHED.what_it_licenses: proceeding to the candidate-estimand shortlist and the clean-run destruction sweep, and nothing else

NO_CANDIDATE_SURVIVES.recorded_as: P-0c determination: no candidate estimand survived the clean-run destruction sweep.
NO_CANDIDATE_SURVIVES.verbatim: Every candidate on the pre-declared shortlist returned a materially non-zero value under a purely destructive patch, computed from clean runs alone. Two natural families had already died this way before the shortlist was written. The measurement is therefore not attempted, because an estimand that moves under pure destruction cannot attribute the movement it reports. NO NEW CANDIDATE IS ADDED: the shortlist was fixed before it was tested, and extending it after seeing which members failed would be selecting the instrument that decides the question.
NO_CANDIDATE_SURVIVES.required_next_action: stop and report; do not add candidates and do not revise the selection rule

4_the_estimand_remains_HELD.why: two natural forms are already proven dead under OD-022, and no functional form may be assumed safe before it passes that sweep
4_the_estimand_remains_HELD.family_1_dead: difference ratios of the form (L_patch - L_clean)/(L_full - L_clean); closed form under pure destruction is -L_clean/(L_full - L_clean), swept mean 0.4997, fraction at or below zero 0.0000
4_the_estimand_remains_HELD.family_2_dead: the rise in the donor answer's own log-probability; a_D is a low-probability token in the recipient's clean run and destruction flattens the distribution, which necessarily lifts low-probability tokens
4_the_estimand_remains_HELD.when_it_is_settled: after the object is established, by the selection rule below, and only once

5_the_selection_rule.shortlist: declared in a separate file before any candidate is evaluated; once declared, no member may be added or removed
5_the_selection_rule.step_1: every candidate must independently pass the OD-022 clean-run destruction sweep; a failure is elimination, not a repair target
5_the_selection_rule.step_2: survivors are evaluated on the CONSTRUCTED object, where the intermediate is known
5_the_selection_rule.step_3: the selected candidate is the one with the largest margin over its own unrelated-donor null ceiling, with at least 5 independent replicates and the ceiling taken as the maximum upper 95 percent bound
5_the_selection_rule.step_4: ALL candidates' numbers are reported, not only the winner's
5_the_selection_rule.step_5: the selected estimand is applied ONLY to the real item set; the selection set and the application set do not overlap and no conclusion is drawn on the selection set
5_the_selection_rule.step_6: one selection only; if zero candidates survive, stop and report and do not add candidates

6_numerical_precision_inherited_and_to_b.the_finding_being_inherited: bfloat16 carries a batch-width-dependent offset of about 0.476 logits, which is the same order as the effects being measured, roughly 0.2 to 0.5
6_numerical_precision_inherited_and_to_b.the_consequence_registered_as_a_limitati: any bfloat16 patching result at this effect scale that has not demonstrated bit-exact no-ops is UNINTERPRETABLE, and this applies to work outside this study as much as inside it
the_three_part_repair_inherited_from_P0_: the baseline is an in-batch self-patch job
the cache is captured at the consuming run's batch width
every chunk is padded to full width
6_numerical_precision_inherited_and_to_b.required: EMBED_NOOP, PREFIX_DONOR and SELF_PATCH all exactly 0.000e+00 over every unit, with the worst single-unit value reported, in bfloat16 AND float32
6_numerical_precision_inherited_and_to_b.units_discipline: the tolerance is on the NORMALISED scale; a raw-logit comparison against it is a units error, and one was caught in P-0' before any verdict was recorded

7_stop_conditions: the object is not established: the ablation probe does not collapse to chance, or accuracy is below the registered floor
any no-op family is not exactly 0.000e+00, at either precision
zero candidate estimands survive the destruction sweep
correct-both units are below the registered floor of 60
continuing would require adding a candidate, or revising the selection rule a second time
lens_A or lens_B is read, or T is touched
continuing would require changing an EQ1, EQ2, P-0 or P-0' criterion, threshold, split or reading
a reboot, resize, configuration change or NSG rule would be needed
a create-only upload hits an If-None-Match precondition failure

8_boundaries.azure: resources are used and never reconfigured; a100-vm, cpuserver and the four TRAINING Standard_NC24s_v3 machines stay running, the V100 machines stay idle and untouched, no NSG rule, nothing resized, rebooted, created or deleted
8_boundaries.cost: no cost-reduction action proposed, performed or discussed
8_boundaries.budget: no GPU-hour ceiling applies; consumption is accounted honestly and NO GATE may be reduced to save time or hours
8_boundaries.blobs: existing blobs immutable; uploads create-only with If-None-Match: *
8_boundaries.T: not touched, not read, not loaded
8_boundaries.predecessors: EQ1, EQ2, P-0 and P-0' artifacts are byte-identical
